title: Read the fields behind the question
alt_text: OBLIGRA VERIFY RESOURCE HUB  /  10 QUESTIONS TO FIELDS Read the fields behind the question Six recurring review questions, mapped to field families. 01 What did the workflow see? input · context 02 How was the model instructed? prompt 03 What did the model produce? output · modelExecution 04 Were controls applied? validation 05 Where does this fit in the business? metadata · index 06 What supports record integrity? verification · retention These fields hold submitted context and service results. Check their content, not just their presence. obligra.ai  /  Resource Hub Concept explainer · Read the linked source
editorial_note: Six mappings preserved; vague trust question narrowed to record integrity.
